caption:
🔥 15 startups were given the opportunity to boost their project through the Silkway Accelerator program. The program is launched by the Astana Hub International Technopark of IT startups in partnership with Google for Startups.
⠀
A total of 330 applications for participation in the program were submitted by technological projects from Central Asian countries, as well as Azerbaijan and Mongolia. The projects were evaluated by a special commission, which included experts from different Central Asian countries, as well as representatives of Google Developers.
⠀
❗️ Program participants will get free access to master classes and mentoring from top Google experts, learn how to effectively set up business processes, scale, build partnerships and prepare for investments.
⠀
Scroll through the list of winners in the carousel. More information about the Silkway Accelerator program can be found at the link in the profile description (taplink).
